items.title: Service readiness
items.description: Provide a small service that operators can start, inspect, and stop predictably.
acceptance_criteria: A new operator can start the service from documented instructions.
The service exposes measurable health evidence.
A failed startup produces an actionable diagnostic.

items.title: Observable service health
items.description: Allow an operator to determine whether the process is ready to serve requests.
acceptance_criteria: A health request returns a success response when dependencies are ready.
A health request returns a non-success response when a required dependency is unavailable.
The response contains no credentials or private configuration values.

items.title: Implement the health endpoint
items.description: Add the endpoint and automated evidence for healthy and unhealthy dependency states.
acceptance_criteria: The healthy case is covered by an automated test.
The unavailable-dependency case is covered by an automated test.
Static checks and the existing test suite pass.

items.title: Document service operations
items.description: Document startup, health verification, shutdown, and the most likely failure modes.
acceptance_criteria: A new operator can follow the instructions without unstated local setup.
Every command has an expected result.
Destructive cleanup actions contain an explicit warning.
